# Advanced Account Hub setup unwraps incoming state and fills a missing outgoing type

Incoming captureState returns a config/edited wrapper, while outgoing captureState returns AccountConfig. The advanced handler unwraps incoming state and fills a missing SMTP type before variable replacement and account creation. The owned patch excludes ews; accepted source later excludes every Exchange config through isExchangeConfig(). Incoming edited state and outgoing completed:false events serve different ordinary-flow retest controls. The browser test directly checks created account fields after confirmation, not network authentication or every error reported in the bug.

Scope: Account Hub advanced setup state.
